text:
alex: kicking off 570 driver canary to eu-west-2, rolling to 20 nodes now. putting notes here so oncall can watch.

maria: saw 4/5 canary nodes fail to come back after reboot, dropping into emergency.target.

sachin: can you paste the journal from one of the failed nodes?

alex: here's the dkms status and the last kernel log from node gpu-eu-02:```
$ dkms status
nvidia, 570.14, 6.1.12-rt1, x86_64: installed
nvidia, 570.14, 6.1.12-rt2, x86_64: added
```
and journal tail:```
Jan 12 03:12:11 gpu-eu-02 kernel: nvidia: failed to initialize module: -22
Jan 12 03:12:11 gpu-eu-02 kernel: nvidia-drm: probe failed with error -22
Jan 12 03:12:12 gpu-eu-02 systemd[1]: Reached emergency.target.
```

katie: error -22 usually indicates module ABI mismatch or bad kernel headers during dkms build. did the node get the updated kernel package at the same time?

dave: provisioning logs show a partial kernel image update landed about 30s before driver restart. suspect race where dkms built against old headers.

maria: confirm: boot hangs start after initramfs tries to load nvidia. If we blacklist nvidia in initramfs nodes boot fine but GPUs not available.

sachin: quick mitigation: pause rollout and mark 570 canary as failed, revert those 20 nodes to 535. I can push a rollout rollback.

infra-bot: deploy pipeline detected failures on canary group (eu-west-2). Failing nodes: gpu-eu-02,gpu-eu-07,gpu-eu-09,gpu-eu-12. Rollout paused.

alex: thanks. also seeing NCCL errors on one node before reboot: "NCCL WARN Call to cudaGetDevice failed: no CUDA-capable device" — consistent with missing module.

katie: we should add a pre-reboot hook to verify kernel headers and run `dkms build` and `dkms install` before swapping kernels. would have caught this.

dave: we've got a shortlist of repro steps. I can repro locally in a containerized kernel chroot.

maria: for immediate ops, suggestion: run `update-initramfs -u -k <kernel>` after dkms reinstall and before reboot. That got two nodes back online.

sachin: I've scheduled a coordinated rollback for the affected nodes, draining them and falling back to the 535 image. planning 10m rolling windows to avoid capacity spike.

alex: note for postmortem: we did a mixed kernel+driver rollout without ordering guarantee across fleet -> race. Need rollout orchestration: drivers before kernel or atomic image swap.

katie: also add a healthcheck that verifies /lib/modules/$(uname -r)/extra/nvidia.ko exists and `nvidia-smi` responds before marking nodes healthy.

deploy-bot: rollback job queued: 4 nodes -> revert driver to 535. ETA 7m.

maria: I'll follow up with logs and a small reproducer. we should also check dedicated capacity in us-west, we reduced burst pool to cover eu-west fallout but want to avoid preemption during business hours.

sachin: interim capacity note: added 2 on-demand GPU nodes in us-west-2, cost estimate ~ $1.4k/day if left >12h. keeping them up only during peak.

alex: thanks team. action items: (1) rollback canary, (2) add preflight dkms check to rollout, (3) implement initramfs regeneration step in image job, (4) write short runbook for oncall to handle similar failures. I'll create GH issues.

maria: tagging @sre for visibility. :eyes:

dave: repro instructions will be uploaded to the infra repo in a minute.

infra-bot: rollback completed for gpu-eu-02,gpu-eu-07,gpu-eu-09,gpu-eu-12. Nodes back on 535.

alex: closing canary for 570 until ordering guarantees present. will reconvene on Monday for plan B. :thumbsup:
